role: CI gate (App Review 5.1.3(ii)): no Swift file that names CKRecord may write a health scalar to a record field, legacy settings fields may only be set to nil, the named payload builders must seal through CloudPayloadCodec.sealForUpload, sealForUpload must fail closed, and the payload readers must decode before decompressing.
toplevel: cd to repo root. No Emuqu/Sources/Storage/CloudKit*.swift -> exit 2. Python over every Swift file under Emuqu and the watch app that contains `CKRecord` (none -> 2): resolves `let name = "literal"` constants (a name maps to every value it has); a write is `<x>record[<literal or constant>] = value` or `.setValue/.setObject(value, forKey: <literal or constant>)`; a key is split into camelCase/snake_case words and is a health field when any word is in HEALTH_WORDS (hr, hrv, rmssd, sdnn, pnn50, heart, pulse, bpm, spo2, oxygen, respiratory, respiration, sleep, recovery, readiness, score, vo2, resting, temperature, alpha1, strain, stress, calories) -> error; settingsJSON/deviceName key with a value other than nil -> error. Writer loop (compressedPayload, compressedPoints, sealedLocalSettings, scrubStoredRecord) under Emuqu/Sources/Storage: not found -> exit 2; function_body (to the closing brace at the declaration's indentation) failing -> exit 2; body without `CloudPayloadCodec.sealForUpload(` -> error. Seal check: function_body of sealForUpload in CloudPayloadCodec.swift; failing -> exit 2; body without `throw CloudSyncError.encryptionUnavailable` -> error; body with `return payload` -> error. Reader loop (decodePoints, decodeSessionAsset): not found or function_body failing -> exit 2; body without DataCompression.decompress -> exit 2; body without CloudPayloadCodec.decode -> error. bad>0 -> exit 1; else clean.

units.does: Prints `func <name>` (matched with a non-identifier character after the name) through the line holding only `}` at the declaration's own indentation, in <file>; awk exits 3 when the function is not found or never closes.
units.entry: Called by the writer, sealForUpload and reader checks in the script body.
